bslAnalyzer.note: Launcher downloads app into %USERPROFILE%\.bsl-analyzer\bin. Prefer launcher asset, not bsl-analyzer-app-*.exe unless you know you need the full binary. The launcher is a separate version line (--launcher-version); to move it, replace %LOCALAPPDATA%\bsl-analyzer\bsl-analyzer.exe -- Windows refuses to overwrite a running exe, so copy the new asset in as a side file, rename the old one to *.bak, then rename the new one onto the battle path. --launcher-update only refreshes the app inside.

mcpToolkit.note: Optional fallback when NinjaLive is unavailable. Download from GitHub releases — do not rely on another machine's C:\1C\soft path.

oneScript.note: No ovm CLI on this machine: update = copy the current slot to a new %LOCALAPPDATA%\ovm\<version>, overlay bin\\* from the GitHub release zip, then repoint the `current` junction (cmd mklink /J). Never overlay lib\ -- it holds opm + vanessa-runner with the local patches from profile/docs-patches/vrunner-local-patches.md. Restart the MCP servers afterwards: a running oscript keeps the engine it was started with.
